title: Maximum of Absolute Value Expression
summary: For two equal-length integer arrays, find the greatest value of the expression |arr1[i] - arr1[j]| + |arr2[i] - arr2[j]| + |i - j| by evaluating it for all valid i and j where 0 <= i, j < arr1.length.
statement: For two equal-length integer arrays, find the greatest value of the expression |arr1[i] - arr1[j]| + |arr2[i] - arr2[j]| + |i - j| by evaluating it for all valid i and j where 0 <= i, j < arr1.length.
hints: Each absolute value can be represented by choosing a sign; paired global negations give four distinct cases.
For each signs on arr1,arr2,index, compute transformed values.
The best pair for that sign case is maximum minus minimum.
One sign case matches the orientations of every optimal i,j pair, so their maximum is exact.
